highlights: **Connected machines:** The environments page becomes a machine map. Link several environments at once, browse linked threads read-only, and connect from a linked thread. Subagents, side chats, and linked threads open consistently. Key-bound direct sessions renew themselves, and peer links renew while used; the fork retains its explicit non-expiring-session option.

**Remote previews and ports:** Desktop can render another environment's localhost tabs locally and forward its ports to this machine. Mobile gains device-local localhost tabs with browser controls. Preview traffic can tunnel to environment loopback ports, with consent and policy controls; preview and device streams survive session renewal.

**Performance:** Long-thread sends, turn starts, shell reads, task follow-ups, and delegated results avoid more full-history scans. VCS and branch snapshots are bounded or released, Git status lookups are batched, and provider snapshots are coalesced by focus. Cursor SDK work moves out of process, slow-disk log writes stop blocking the service, and file previews avoid unchanged reloads. These changes do not claim general database compaction.

**Agent tools and PRs:** Agents can read, open, update, review, and merge PRs, inspect failing CI logs, rerun checks, and land GitHub stacks. PR reads default to a compact summary, creation pushes unpushed branches, and watches report completed checks and merges. Thread turns can return typed results; issue lists can include a fork and its upstream.

**Providers and background work:** Many Antigravity fixes cover sign-in, skills, compaction, background commands, usage, and recovery. Cursor background commands survive turns and wake the agent on exit. Claude, Codex, Pi, and ACP gain history, steering, subagent, and cleanup fixes. Threads remain Working for relevant background waits and PR watches.

**Mobile and daily workflow:** Select, cite, and comment on assistant text, share guest threads, and collapse long user messages. Android gains corrected diff highlights and fixes for SVG and image-gallery crashes. File selection survives virtualized scrolling, PDF previews avoid reloads, secret cards gain show/hide and multiple values, and dictation capture starts sooner on iOS and desktop.

**Reliability and security:** Stalled update downloads resume, managed T3 Connect tunnels survive service updates, and reconnect loops recover from unexpected failures. Revoking other clients also revokes unused pairing codes; forge credentials stay on their intended hosts. Atomic saves preserve permissions, managed provider runtimes prune old versions, and cleanup recognizes clean detached worktrees whose commits are on a branch.
